criteria_source: Coverage fractions of 85% are informational reporting references only and never exclude candidates. Shared-position challenges require at least 100,000 aligned target bases and half of the larger pairwise aligned target span. These provisional evidence floors are not calibrated strain cutoffs; failing them keeps an alternative unresolved rather than promoting another reference. At most three verification passes use cached target calls. No density or contig-edge SNP masking is applied.
metric: ACGT substitutions in unambiguously mapped one-to-one alignments; indels and ambiguous bases reported separately
